title: BUYING The Dip in 4 Stocks Before 2027
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Mark Roussin opens with the market picture after a brutal week for tech and the Nvidia leadership shock: the S&P 500 gained about 2.5% on the week, the Nasdaq 2.3% in its best week since August, the Dow 2.1% and the Russell 2000 1.3%, with all four still positive on the year, and he warns against confusing short-term volatility with the market falling apart. He then presents four stocks he is looking to buy before 2027, chosen for quality businesses, more reasonable valuations and big upside rather than simply the largest falls. Caterpillar is down over 40% from July highs on AI-buildout fears, but power generation for data centres is the underappreciated driver, with an edge score of 82, forward P/E of 18.8, PEG near 1 and an analyst target near $918. Boeing is a multi-year turnaround with 635 commercial deliveries in the trailing twelve months, its highest in seven years, an all-time-high backlog and earnings turning positive next year. Robinhood has evolved beyond meme trading into a diversified financial platform, down 35% in twelve months with EPS up about 40% next year. AMD is his highest-conviction growth stock on the MI400/Helios rack-scale platform and hyperscalers diversifying away from Nvidia after Jensen's exit. Calls: CAT BUY (first tracked); BA BUY (first tracked); HOOD BUY, flipped from UNCERTAIN; AMD BUY, BUY reiterated. He notes his Nvidia position remains in the portfolio but makes no new Nvidia call. (Auto-captions garble 'Jensen' as 'Jensen sleeping around' in one aside.)
